entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ファヒータ店の前で仲間が撃たれたらしい。きっとヴァレンティーノズの仕業だ" t="You hear they gunned down one of ours? In front of that fajita joint – Valentinos." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ファヒータ店の前で仲間が撃たれたらしい。きっとヴァレンティーノズの仕業だ" t="Ai auzit că l-au nimerit pe unu’ de-ai noștri? În fața jointului ăluia cu fajitas – Valentinos." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="相変わらずの単細胞ぶりだな。ありゃ粛清だ。あいつはNCPDのスパイだったんだよ" t="So fajitas equals Valentinos? You gonk, that was us. The fucker was an NCPD mole." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="相変わらずの単細胞ぶりだな。ありゃ粛清だ。あいつはNCPDのスパイだったんだよ" t="Deci fajitas înseamnă Valentinos? Fraierule, noi am fost. Nenorocitul era cârtiță la NCPD." b="" a=""/>
